sentences.text: Shri Rizwan Khan, G.A. for the Respondent-State.
Issue show cause notice to Respondent No. 1 The Food Inspector Shri Arunesh Kumar Patel and Respondent No. 2 on payment of P.F. within a week by both mode.
Notice be made returnable within three weeks.
Also heard on I.A.No.14828/19 application for stay of the proceedings pending before the trial Court.

Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, it is directed that till further orders, proceedings of the trial Court in connection with Criminal Case No. 8439/2011 pending before the Special Magistrate (Food Adulteration and Prevention) Act, Bhopal, shall remain stayed.
